_doc: Seamless streaming between wings (workstream SEAMLESS, Nov 13 2026; design/godot-wings.md 'Seamless streaming'). scripts/wing_stream.gd reads this.
_enabled: false until every interior border is converted (Stage 3) and Steven has seen it: ?stream=1 turns it on for a session, ?stream=0 off. May also be one value per kind of device: {"desktop": true, "mobile": false}.
_borders: Stage 2: the wing 1 <-> wing 2 seam in the 1990s only.
_wing2_zones: the same list as tools/build_mall.gd WING2_ZONES: a mall wing's copy of the other wing's halls and courts (meshes named by zone) is hidden while the real wing is in.
_near_m: start loading a neighbour when the player is within this many metres of the border. Desktop: always (the whole interior after the first load screen).
_far_m: phones and tablets: a neighbour further than this from the player is unloaded.
_handoff_past_m: the wing's own systems (shops, attendants, items, shoppers, signs) follow the player once they are this far past the border.
